name: feature-workflow
description: Feature lifecycle skills for AI coding agents: /ship-feature (the whole loop from a Jira ticket key or a brief; entry-state aware, crash-safe with --resume, autonomous merge gate), /ticket-intake (Jira issue → numbered requirements with verbatim quotes), /plan-feature, /build-feature, /mr-review (independent external reviewers with context pack, static pre-pass, delta re-review), /address-review (honest triage and resolution), /resolve-conflicts (automatic conflict resolution that keeps review threads anchored), /ticket-report (one Jira comment with per-requirement coverage and a status transition that never claims Done on partial work), /land (post-merge runbook)
